name: Tomb Raider IV•V•VI Remastered: Deluxe Edition
summary:
Play the next series of Tomb Raider adventures in this remastered collection of the Darkness Trilogy.

See the Classic & Remastered Visuals: Play with the original polygonal models or swap to the remastered graphics at any time.

Travel the Globe: Follow Lara Croft around iconic locales including Cairo, Rome, Paris, and many more Experience Lara’s Darkest Adventures: Uncover the secrets of Lara Croft’s past and shed light on the mystery of her disappearance.

Tomb Raider IV-VI Remastered Deluxe Edition includes:

- the physical game steelbook
- an exploration map book
- a greatest hits music CD
- collector’s box
